svg.title: Agent architectures with descriptions
svg.desc: Five agent architectures in increasing order of capability, each with its defining behavior: simple reflex agent, model-based reflex agent, goal-based agent, utility-based agent, and learning agent.

g.text: Selects actions using condition-action rules on the current percept
Works only in simple, fully observable environments
Maintains internal state to track hidden, unobserved aspects
Combines current percept with history to choose actions
Uses goals plus search or planning to pick actions
Chooses actions expected to reach the goal state
Uses a utility function to score possible outcomes
Selects the action with the highest expected utility
Improves its behavior over time from experience
Adapts strategy using feedback from a performance element
